title: Work Journal suggestions: one summary per project per day, and update suggestions that rewrite its card
summary: Work Journal suggestions now give each project one short summary a day; once it is a card, later work arrives as an update showing old text struck through above the new, Accept rewrites the card and Reject leaves it, and a waiting summary is rewritten in place.
friction: The dev agent's full gate was killed by Claude Code for critically low memory (7.8 GB machine, parallel cargo test and vitest); a resumed run with one command at a time, vitest --maxWorkers=2 and cargo -j 2 passed, costing about 20 minutes
lessons_learned: On this machine tell dev and review agents to run gate commands one at a time with npm test -- --maxWorkers=2 and cargo test --workspace -j 2
